name: Kuroki Michi
source:
The academy monitor and Nora's childhood friend. She is currently studying abroad temporarily to further her education. Without expecting much, she decided to participate in a quiz show and ended up getting an incredibly high score.

“Everyone! Long time no see! Right now it's nighttime over here!”
